feed.title: RealScale-Pro Releases
feed.subtitle: Free, open-source, offline AI image upscaler for Android (Vulkan ncnn & MNN)

entry.title: RealScale-Pro v2.3.1 — Strict 100% Offline Release
entry.summary: Strictly on-device offline architecture (20.50 MiB arm64 APK), reliable Result screen arrival after every upscale, stable 9:16 portrait preview on Config, and resilient single/batch URI import.

entry.title: RealScale-Pro v2.2.2 — Thermal Guard, EXIF Metadata & TTA
entry.summary: Added platform ThermalGuard throttling, EXIF metadata preservation, SAF custom save folder, 8-way TTA quality switch, input/output compression controls, and stable update signing.
